page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Tyrannosaurus?

The bioluminescent Tyrannosaurus is a genetically modified hybrid of Tyrannosaurus rex and cuttlefish that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

The bioluminescent Tyrannosaurus appears as an optional skin variant for the Tyrannosaurus rex. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Tyrannosaurus rex DNA; 2 samples of any Latge DNA; and 1 sample of Cuttlefish DNA.
